text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that usually need human intelligence, such as understanding language or making decisions. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask voice assistants questions, get movie recommendations, or use translation apps. It also helps doctors find diseases and makes self-driving cars possible. AI is changing the way we live and work.
